# `scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/compare_halos.py`

Source: [compare_halos.py](../../../../scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/compare_halos.py)

```text
Compare the halo catalogues of a Gadget-4 and a pkdgrav3 run from the same ICs (consistent-trees hlists
out_<snap>.trees and value-added catalogues out_<snap>.vahc of the Sahyadri pipeline; Rockstar out_<snap>.list
where there is no hlist).

usage: compare_halos.py <gadget_halo_dir> <pkd_halo_dir> <out_dir> --outs 20,50,80,100 [--mbins ...]

Per output:
  mass functions dn/dlog10M (h^3 Mpc^-3) of host halos (pid = -1) in Mvir and M200b, Vmax function,
  subhalo fraction;
  host halos matched one to one: mutual nearest centres (periodic) within 0.5 Rvir_gadget and |log10 Mvir ratio|
  < 0.5; per Mvir_gadget bin: matched fraction and the median and 16/84 percentiles of pkd / gadget ratios
  (Mvir, M200b, Vmax, Rvir/rs, Spin_Bullock, b_to_a, c_to_a, T/|U|), of the centre offset / Rvir and |v_pkd - v_gadget|
  (bulk velocity, km/s), and of the VAHC quantities (b1, lam1..3 at R = 2 and 4 R200b) of matched halos.
Output in out_dir: halo_mf.csv, halo_match.csv, halo_match_out<i>.npz (matched pairs, for the report notebook).
```

## Contents

- [`read_cat`](#read_cat) - -&gt; dict of arrays (lower-case Rockstar names as in the hlist) or None
- [`mf`](#mf) - Mass (or velocity) function: counts per bin, dn/dlog10 m per volume `vol` and its Poisson error.
- [`match`](#match) - Match Gadget-4 halos `hg` to pkdgrav3 halos `hp` in a periodic box of size `L`.
- [`pct`](#pct) - Median, 16th and 84th percentiles of the finite values of `x` (NaNs if none).
- [`main`](#main) - Command line (see `--help`): halo mass and velocity functions of the two codes and the matched-halo ratios per output, written as CSV files to `out_dir`.

## read_cat

```python
read_cat(d, i)
```

-&gt; dict of arrays (lower-case Rockstar names as in the hlist) or None

## mf

```python
mf(m, edges, vol)
```

Mass (or velocity) function: counts per bin, dn/dlog10 m per volume `vol` and its Poisson error.

## match

```python
match(hg, hp, L)
```

Match Gadget-4 halos `hg` to pkdgrav3 halos `hp` in a periodic box of size `L`.

A pair matches if each is the other's nearest neighbour, the separation is below half the Gadget Rvir
(kpc/h -&gt; Mpc/h) and the masses agree within a factor 10^0.5. Returns indices into `hg` and `hp` and
the separations.

## pct

```python
pct(x)
```

Median, 16th and 84th percentiles of the finite values of `x` (NaNs if none).

## main

```python
main()
```

Command line (see `--help`): halo mass and velocity functions of the two codes and the matched-halo
ratios per output, written as CSV files to `out_dir`.
